title: Rav Ada Mari
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Zevachim 38a, according to Dikdukei Soferim: Rava said, “Rav Ada Mari explained it to me”; the text Hyman uses reads Bar Ada Mari. In Moed Katan 16a: “Ada Mari said that Nechemyah bar Barukh said,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Zevachim 38a has Rava say that Bar Ada Mari explained the point to him. Moed Katan 16a has untitled Ada Mari reporting Nechemyah bar Baruch, who reports Rav Chiyya bar Avin and Rav Yehudah. Hyman's full Rav heading and his reported Dikdukei Soferim reading are preserved; the apparatus report was not directly collated.
